what: supplement 4A to the night-1 pre-registration: two pieces of work on the CPU only, ruled on 2026-10-20 (third supplement to the design ticket)

num_candidates_probe.why: C1's default query (k = num_candidates = 100) gave nDCG@10 0.6759 against Vol.4's exact 0.80079 on the same vectors (known before this supplement)
num_candidates_probe.the_blueprint_knob: one setting moves both numbers: VECTOR_DB_TOPK (or a request's vdb_top_k). The Blueprint passes k = fetch_k = top_k (utils/vdb/elasticsearch/elastic_vdb.py, retrieval_langchain) and langchain-elasticsearch 1.0.0 in the rag-server image passes num_candidates = fetch_k (_sync/vectorstores.py:481). The Blueprint accepts 1..400 (rag_server/validation.py:139). The same number is the count of passages sent to the reranker

settings.blueprint: k = num_candidates = 200 and 400 (400 is the Blueprint's limit); all returned passages kept, the quality read on the first 100
settings.es_only: k = 100, num_candidates = 200, 500 and 1000 (the search engine's own setting; the ruling's 500 and 1000 are beyond the Blueprint's knob, so they are listed apart)

num_candidates_probe.unchanged: the index (the same one, no force-merge), the mapping's rescore_vector oversample 3.0, the query vectors
num_candidates_probe.measured: per setting, all 7,405 questions: overlap at 10 and 100 with Vol.4's exact run, nDCG@10 and Recall@100; the index's segment count (_cat/segments) before the probe
num_candidates_probe.latency: not measured (latency_not_measured: daytime_host); the clean window of the night times a fixed 1,000 questions
num_candidates_probe.expectation: quality rises with num_candidates and stays below the exact search at every setting; confidence low

miracl_zh_index.precondition: at least 80 GB free on the disk after the load (the index of HotpotQA took 52.9 GB for 5.2 million passages)
miracl_zh_index.load: es_bulk_load.py, unchanged, into index miracl_zh_whole with the captured mapping and metadata template; MIRACL zh's 4,934,368 passages with Vol.4's vectors from the 16-bit store
miracl_zh_index.validity_gate: a 100,000-passage slice (the first 100,000 in corpus order) loaded by the same program into miracl_zh_slice100k; Elasticsearch's exact search there against numpy's exact search over the same vectors for the first 200 question ids (sorted) of MIRACL zh dev: every question equal once equal-score swaps at the 100th place are set aside (exact_equal_check.py, tie 5e-5). Not passed: no figure of the zh index is reported
miracl_zh_index.measured: as C1: the default query (k = num_candidates = 100) for all 393 dev questions: overlap at 10 and 100 with Vol.4's exact run (whole-corpus run of the published volume), nDCG@10 and Recall@100 with MIRACL's dev judgements; negative control (k 10, num_candidates 10, no rescore) at least 0.05 lower at 10; 5 questions by brute force on the whole index against Vol.4's exact; load seconds, index size, Docker VM memory every 30 s
miracl_zh_index.latency: not measured by day (latency_not_measured: daytime_host); the clean window of the night times it
miracl_zh_index.qrels: qrels.miracl-v1.0-zh-dev.tsv is in TREC form; it is read as TREC (a copy with the .trec extension, bytes unchanged)
miracl_zh_index.expectation: overlap at 100 below HotpotQA's 0.784 or near it; nDCG@10 below Vol.4's exact; confidence low
